name: ceo-inbox-archive
description: Archive a message in the principal's email by removing it from the INBOX folder. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's email, do not call from other agents. During triage, a mailbox whose ceo_inbox/filing is leave_in_inbox is marked read instead and stays in the inbox.

inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)

outputs.subject: string (subject of the archived message; omitted when it has none)
outputs.from: string (sender as "Name (email)" or just the email; omitted when unknown)
outputs.already_archived: boolean (true when the message was not in the inbox, so nothing changed; omitted otherwise)
outputs.left_in_inbox: boolean (true when the mailbox's filing setting kept it in the inbox, marked read; omitted otherwise)
